note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden flags follow the official list: 28 hidden. Guides are our own words, written from the official descriptions; the game is a day old and nothing here is confirmed in the game yet.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then activities, then collectibles — and leave the 100% completion trophy for last, since it is the longest grind of the lot.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which introduces Lucia and Jason. It comes early in the story, so it unlocks naturally as you play; there is nothing to prepare for.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Keep playing the story missions in order; chapters close as the story advances, so this one is automatic.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long one: it counts story, activities, collectibles and side content together. Use the in-game checklist to find what is left, and treat it as the last trophy before the platinum.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 100. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses and air time in vehicles, and they add up across free roam. Pick fast vehicles, use ramps and jumps, and let the counter climb — the in-game stats page shows your total.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 250. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample one of everything — races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting and the rest — rather than grinding one. One try each is enough.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 9. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through every challenge at the range and aim for gold on each; silver or bronze does not count. Practice the weapon types you are weakest with first.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 42. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course, then win it; a win at all 14 locations is what counts, so keep a list of the ones you have won.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 14. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races across Leonida and win 20 distinct ones — repeats do not add to the count. Mix race types so you are always working on a new one.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 20. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal, take his challenge and out-fish him. Watch his score and fish steadily rather than rushing.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Find the meditation spots — they appear as you explore — and meditate at each. Keep a checklist; finding the spots is the hard part, not the meditating. Spots may unlock as the story advances, so revisit areas after each chapter.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 18. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunt, track the animal he names, and bring it down. Hunting rewards patience: track, stay downwind, and take a clean shot.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find the cards scattered around Leonida and finish three full sets. Cards are a collectible hunt — check the map as you explore, and trade duplicates if the game allows it.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 3. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK It action has 100 spots; do it at each one. Work through the map area by area so none are missed.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 100. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; finish any 50. They stack up naturally across activities, so check the challenges list for the ones nearest done.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 50. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. Use hiding spots and avoid the search cones.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving — do not stop to fight. If the wanted level drops between shops, the chain breaks.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or find 100 different vehicles; each new one you get into counts. Try dealerships, traffic and parked cars across the map.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 100. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with a group of enemies in front of you and drop five before it ends. Pick a spot with clustered enemies and a strong weapon.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This reads like a one-time story set-piece at the airport, so it is flagged missable. If it is tied to a mission, do it when the moment comes, and check the mission replay menu before moving past the chapter.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos. Rhinos are tanks — the description jokes about hot tank interiors, so expect a mission or event involving them. Take heavy weapons and cover when one shows up.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards, take what you need and leave before anyone raises the alarm. A failed attempt can be retried, so learn the patrols first.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults are bigger jobs than shops — plan the approach and the getaway, and escape clean after each one. Five vaults, five escapes.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 5. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop a truck, take its cargo and get away before the police close in. Pick a quiet stretch of road for the hit.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Visit every named area on the map. The in-game map tracks what you have seen, so sweep the state region by region.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 52. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one operation per gang and hit it. Gangs hold different parts of the map, so this is also a tour of Leonida's underworld.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 9. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail where you can see the water. Flagged as possibly missable: it reads like a story scene, so do it when the moment comes if it appears in a mission.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PSN tracks a count toward 500, so this is about decisions across the game. Flagged as possibly missable: choices can lock outcomes, so consider keeping a save before big decisions.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 500. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try. It likely pops when a retry succeeds — deliberately failing once and then winning is the straightforward read.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange happens — a random or scripted odd event. Flagged as possibly missable because it may be a one-time event; explore odd places and watch for it.

trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass and swing as you go by.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through contacts until $250,000 is clean. It is a slow earner — keep laundering as you play rather than saving it for the end.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 250000. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and upgrades until the total passes $100,000. Spending counts across every shop, so it adds up as you play.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 100000. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage on the market. Save money for them and check property listings as new areas open.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 8. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find 10 vehicles and register each in the app. Any vehicle you drive can be registered, so do it as you discover new ones.
trophies.sources: Official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): name, description, grade and the PSN count of 10. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
